applies_to.description: Control IDs this exception bypasses. An exception referencing no live control fails gate V-7.

mechanism.description: Added in spec 1.0.0. The bypass mechanism is itself an attack surface. Strength order is enforced by gate X-1.

kind.description: Preference order, strongest first. 'ip', 'asn', 'user-agent' and 'path' are spoofable or over-broad and require justification plus a shortened expiry.

host_count_estimate.description: For asn/ip-range bypasses: how many hosts does this actually trust? An ASN can hold thousands.

compensating_control.description: Added in spec 1.0.0. What covers the risk while this exception is live? The original register had no such field, which is how a 12-month WAF bypass on an unauthenticated webhook path gets approved without anyone noticing.

none_because.description: If genuinely no compensating control exists, say so explicitly. Silence is not permitted.

blast_radius.description: Added in spec 1.0.0. What is reachable if this exception is abused or the bypassed party is compromised?

expiry_action.description: Added in spec 1.0.0. Undefined expiry behaviour is how every register drifts into permanent exceptions. 'auto-extend' is deliberately not an option.

usage.description: Observed hit count. An exception with zero usage is dead weight; retire it.
